answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 21303 Country: India Title: I went to perform Umrah from Bombay to Jeddah and entered state of Ihram from Bahrain as the meeqat comes during the flight from Bahrain. Alhamdulillah as I intended to do Umrah, I completed my Umrah and did another umrah from Masjid - e- Aisha. I then went next day to Medina to visit Masjid e Nabuwi and on returning I did not intend to do Umrah again and returned from Medina to Makaah without Ihram. Have I committed a mistake? and if yes what should I do as now I am back in Bombay. Please advice urgently. Question: Assalaamu Aalaikum Mufti Saab, I went to perform Umrah from Bombay to Jeddah and entered state of Ihram from Bahrain as the meeqat comes during the flight from Bahrain. Alhamdulillah as I intended to do Umrah, I completed my Umrah and did another umrah from Masjid - e- Aisha. I then went next day to Medina to visit Masjid e Nabuwi and on returning I did not intend to do Umrah again and returned from Medina to Makaah without Ihram. Have I committed a mistake? and if yes what should I do as now I am back in Bombay. Please advice urgently. Answer ID: 21303 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 763/609/B=1431) In the question mentioned above one dam (slaughtering animal) is wajib due to passing from miqat without wearing ihram. Now you should send the price of one medium goat by which a goat could be slaughtered within the boundary of Holy Haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
